Method of Attack: Planting a PHP web shell backdoor named 'twitter_icon_<random string>' on a CentOS system to listen for HTTP POST requests and execute commands
Using the backdoor to deploy Lorenz ransomware after a dormant period
Attack Vector: Leveraging vulnerabilities within two Mitel PHP pages to retrieve and install web shell
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of PHP web shell named 'twitter_icon_<random string>' in legitimate directory
Use of HTTP POST requests with parameters 'id' and 'img' to control web shell
